title: Length of the next search interval
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a linearly ordered type, let $k$ be a natural number, let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$, and let $x\in\alpha$. Define the next length to be the number of entries strictly below $x$ if at least $k$ entries are strictly below $x$; otherwise, define it to be the number of entries strictly above $x$ if fewer than $k$ entries are at most $x$; in all other cases, define it to be zero.
